paper_title: CoreValue：面向价值观计算的中文核心价值-行为体系及知识库
caption: 基于RoBERTa的价值类别方向联合判别个价值方向别性能比较（F1）
model_annotation:
This bar chart compares the performance of two categories, 激活 (activation) and 抑制 (inhibition), across nine core values. The horizontal axis lists the core values, which are 文明 (civilization), 公正 (justice), 平等 (equality), 法治 (rule of law), 爱国 (patriotism), 敬业 (dedication), 诚信 (integrity), and 友善 (benevolence). The vertical axis represents the F1 scores, ranging from 0 to 1, with increments of 0.1. 

The chart features two colors: yellow for 激活 (activation) and dark grey for 抑制 (inhibition). The shortest bar for 激活 (activation) is approximately 0.7 for 公正 (justice) and 文明 (civilization), while the longest bar is around 0.95 for 友善 (benevolence). For 抑制 (inhibition), the shortest bar is about 0.8 for 文明 (civilization), and the longest bar is approximately 1 for 爱国 (patriotism). The bars for 抑制 (inhibition) are generally longer than those for 激活 (activation), except for 友善 (benevolence), where 激活 (activation) has a slightly higher value. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there is no visual emphasis on any of the bars.
